title: Personal Portfolio
description: This very site — a bilingual, animated portfolio built to double as a live demonstration of the front-end craft it describes, its interactive starfield turning the "vast universe of technology" into something you can move through.
role: Sole designer and developer — from the design system and content architecture to the animation and deployment.
challenge: A portfolio has to be more than a résumé: it needs to prove the craft it claims, stay fast and accessible, and speak to visitors in both English and Spanish — while carrying a point of view rather than reading as a neutral template.
decision: Build on Astro for a near-static, SEO-strong shell, add React islands only where interaction earns them, and layer GSAP and Three.js motion over a hand-built design system, shipped on Cloudflare. The interactive Three.js starfield behind everything isn't decoration — it makes the About section's "vast universe of technology" literal, dropping visitors inside a space they can zoom through, a quiet echo of the restless, self-taught curiosity and the "never stop evolving" ethos that run through the whole site.
roleShort: Sole designer and developer, end to end
challengeShort: A portfolio that proves the craft it describes
decisionShort: Astro shell with React islands, GSAP and Three.js motion

title: Workflow Orchestration Audit
description: An audit, refactor, and UI/UX overhaul of a workflow-orchestration front-end originally assembled with AI coding assistants.
role: Owned the front-end audit, refactor, and follow-on feature work — first assessing the existing codebase, then hardening it and building on top.
challenge: The interface had been put together largely with AI coding assistants, so reusability, consistency, and stability were uneven across the codebase and hard to build on safely.
decision: Audit first for reusability and best practices, stabilize the foundation, and only then layer on the UI/UX polish and the new features the product needed.
roleShort: Front-end audit, refactor, and feature work
challengeShort: Turn AI-generated code into a reusable, stable codebase
decisionShort: Establish best practices before polishing UI/UX and adding features

title: Product Marketing Site
description: A marketing landing taken from Figma to production — engineered for speed and SEO, and editable by non-developers.
role: Led the front-end architecture, SEO, and deployment, carrying the design from Figma through to a production, marketing-ready site.
challenge: Marketing needed a fast, SEO-strong landing page, but also the freedom to create and edit pages later without pulling a developer into every change.
decision: A content-editable Astro architecture tuned for performance and SEO, wired to analytics and delivered through Cloudflare for fast, low-friction publishing.
challengeShort: Ship an SEO-strong landing the team can edit without developers
decisionShort: A content-editable Astro architecture delivered on Cloudflare

title: Logistics Finance Module
description: A finance module for a US logistics company that unifies previously separate tools into one interface, wiring the front-end to automated accounting workflows.
role: Implemented the finance module's front-end while aligning with a large team mid-refactor, working in parallel on the slice I owned.
challenge: The company juggled two to three separate systems to run its internal finance operations, fragmenting both the interface and the day-to-day workflow.
decision: Unify them behind a single Next.js/GraphQL interface connected to n8n workflows that bridge to QuickBooks, so the work lives in one place.
roleShort: Front-end implementation within a large refactor team
challengeShort: Replace two to three disconnected systems with one UI
decisionShort: A Next.js/GraphQL front-end wired to n8n and QuickBooks

title: Remittance Operations Platform
description: A single source of truth for a remittance and currency-exchange operation, where each operator works only within the modules their daily role requires.
role: Defined the front-end architecture and orchestrated the UI/UX for the platform end to end.
challenge: Operators needed one authoritative workspace to send and receive remittances, without exposing every user to the full breadth of the system.
decision: Modular sub-pages, each holding its own business logic, gated by a scope-based permission system that narrows every operator to just their daily operations.
challengeShort: One authoritative workspace without exposing the whole system
decisionShort: Modular sub-pages gated by a scope-based permission system

title: I.R Management Platform
description: A multi-application investor-relations platform that pairs a shared interface language with dense operational data.
role: Built reusable UI patterns and complex data visualizations across the platform's independent sub-applications.
challenge: Several independent investor-relations apps had to feel like one coherent product while surfacing dense, operational market data.
decision: Anchor every implementation in the company design system, keeping the sub-apps consistent and usable as the platform grew.
roleShort: Reusable UI patterns and complex data visualizations
challengeShort: Keep independent sub-apps consistent and usable
decisionShort: Anchor implementation in the company design system

title: inUI Library
description: A headless internal UI library giving product teams a cohesive foundation for application interfaces, used across a 30–50-person firm.
role: Co-authored the headless component library at the core of the product suite, adopted across a 30–50-person firm.
challenge: Teams needed to ship faster without each product drifting into its own inconsistent, hard-to-maintain interface.
decision: Headless, business-logic-aware components that stayed flexible enough to cut manual development time by ~50–70% once the library stabilized.
roleShort: Co-author of the headless component library
challengeShort: Move faster without fragmenting the experience
decisionShort: Headless components that cut development time ~50–70%

title: Investor Onboarding Portal
description: An investor registration and document-management platform that brings KYC and compliance into a single onboarding flow.
role: Co-developed the registration and document-management platform that brings KYC and compliance together in one flow.
challenge: Investor onboarding was slow and paperwork-heavy, scattered across disconnected steps that were easy to abandon.
decision: Unify registration, documents, KYC, and compliance into a single guided onboarding experience that moves investors through in order.
roleShort: Co-developer of the registration and document platform
decisionShort: Unify registration, documents, KYC, and compliance

title: Credit Healing UI Library
description: A 30-component Vue design system — inputs, layout, and data display with full variants — unifying the UI across multiple fintech products under one brand.
role: Co-architected the Vue design system underpinning the company's fintech products.
challenge: Multiple independent products under one fintech brand were drifting apart, both visually and in how their components behaved.
decision: A shared 30-component library — inputs, layout, and data display with full variants — documented in Storybook so every product could reuse it consistently.
roleShort: Co-architect of the Vue design system
challengeShort: Unify the UI across independent fintech products
decisionShort: A shared 30-component library, documented in Storybook

title: Covid News Dashboard
description: An interactive dashboard for following COVID-19 statistics through real-time regional views.
role: Built the data-visualization dashboard end to end.
challenge: Multiple data sources had to become a live, regional breakdown of COVID-19 statistics that stayed readable at a glance.
decision: Aggregate several APIs and render them as real-time regional views with amCharts 4.
challengeShort: Turn multiple data sources into real-time regional views
decisionShort: Aggregate multiple APIs and render them with amCharts 4

title: Social News Dashboard
description: A social-news aggregator that keeps defined trending topics visible without requiring visitor input.
role: Built the continuously updating, hands-free news interface.
challenge: Defined trending topics needed to stay current and visible without ever asking the visitor to interact.
decision: Continuously fetch and auto-scroll the selected topics, so the feed stays live and up to date on its own.
roleShort: Built the continuously updating news interface
challengeShort: Surface social trends with no user interaction required
decisionShort: Continuously update and auto-scroll the trending topics

title: Material Start Page
description: My first frontend project: a responsive start page built from the ground up with Material Design principles.
role: Sole author — my first frontend project, built entirely from scratch.
challenge: Recreate a polished, fully responsive start page on Material Design principles without leaning on any UI framework.
decision: Hand-build every component from the ground up, keeping it responsive across screen sizes.
roleShort: Sole author — my first frontend project
challengeShort: Build every component from scratch on Material Design
decisionShort: Hand-built all components with no UI framework
